jobs.title: Head/VP of Product (AI Process Insights & Automation)
jobs.notes:
What they sell: Process intelligence software. Their AI records the clicks and keystrokes that make up real office work and turns them into process maps, which enterprises use to decide what to improve or automate, and increasingly to train agentic AI on real workflows.
Funding: About $34.8M raised in total. Series B of $26.2M closed September 2025.
Investors: Paladin Capital Group (led the Series B), Khosla Ventures, LGVP, Entrepreneurs First.
Team size: Around 190 employees. Headquartered in London, distributed across North America and Western Europe. Reported ARR growth of over 570% in 18 months, serving 30+ large enterprises including several Fortune 500s.
Role: First Head of Product hire at the company. Owns global product strategy and the macro roadmap, mentors the Product Managers and Designers, sets the product operating model, handles capacity forecasting and hiring, and resolves stakeholder conflicts. Works directly with and reports into the CEO and CTO.
Source: LinkedIn, live-checked 2026-07-31 - active, posted 6 days ago, 50 applicants. Fully remote, explicitly open to Western Europe and North America with a preference for timezone overlap, so Oslo qualifies. No application deadline stated. | [Re-saved 2026-08-02 — already tracked, no action]
jobs.cover_letter:
Most agent companies are guessing at what enterprise work actually looks like. Mimica is one of the few with a real recording of it, which makes the product question less about capability and more about which parts of that map become product and which stay a service. That choice gets harder, not easier, after 570% ARR growth and thirty large customers pulling in different directions.

At Gelato I am SVP Product, and I built the GelatoConnect AI Estimator: zero to more than $2M ARR in six months, 65% less manual quoting effort, and quote time down from 30 to 60 minutes to 15 seconds. That was this same problem, taking messy operational work and deciding what to automate first. Before Gelato I spent 11 years at Schlumberger across 15 countries in industrial operations.

As the first product leadership hire, I would want to know where you think process intelligence stops and agent execution starts. Happy to connect.

I built the GelatoConnect AI Estimator, which passed $2M ARR in six months and cut quote time from 30-60 minutes to 15 seconds by turning a messy manual process into one shared capability. I line-manage product managers and own budget and outcomes for my area.

I would like to understand how you decide when a partner need becomes a platform feature and when it stays a local configuration. Happy to connect.
